headline: CELEBRITY 🕵️‍♂️ TRAITORS 🔪 Connections That Will 🍆 SHOCK You 😱
text:
ROMESH 🍑 RANGANATHAN just casually DROPPED 💦 that he's sat 🍑 next to ROB 🐺 BECKETT during a full COLONIC 🚽 and we all knew this CELEBRITY 🕵️‍♂️ TRAITORS season was gonna get MESSY 🌀!! Their decade long BROMANCE 💑 from ROB 🍆 AND ROMESH VS travel 🍌 shows plus endless MOCK 🃏 THE WEEK panel gigs means these two are basically MARRIED 👰‍♂️ but in the castle 🏰 that friendship might get RAILED 💦 hard!! Romesh straight up admitted 🗣️ his bestie is just as likely to TWIST 🌀 THE KNIFE in his back as he is to have his back and we're seated 🍿 for every second of this unhinged dynamic!! "He's one of my best friends" he said before the show but we all know that in Traitors world even the tightest bonds get TESTED 🧪 to DESTRUCTION 💥!!

JOE 🦒 LYCETT is out here besties 🤝 with JAMES 🍑 ACASTER complete with that running joke where everyone mixes them up while they cohosted TRAVEL 🧳 MAN and now those loyalties are getting STRETCHED 🥴 like never before especially since Acaster got recruited as a TRAITOR 🗡️!! Lycett also calls JOANNE 🧿 MCNALLY one of his favourite people in the entire world 🌍 but with so many comedians crammed in this castle every single alliance is basically edging 😩 on the brink of total collapse!! Joanne swore they "haven't been in cahoots" and that they're all ready to throw each other under the BUS 🚌 but we see you comedians 🃏 nervously side eyeing each other knowing one wrong glance could end the friendship forever!! Acaster himself called the other comics his BIGGEST THREAT ⚠️ because they know he doesn't flip his mind overnight and we're down bad 🍆 just watching it unfold!!

MAYA 🦋 JAMA and AMOL 📻 RAJAN the two broadcasters are connected to literally everyone in the cast like some six degrees of thirsty separation 🌐!! Amol had Michael Sheen and Joe Lycett on his Radio 2 Breakfast show interviewed Romesh on BBC Asian Network and popped up with Ross Kemp Miranda Hart James Blunt and Hannah Fry but sadly he became the FIRST 🥇 player MURDERED 🔪 before we could see those past links get weaponized!! Maya meanwhile hosted the BRIT AWARDS 🎤 with James Blunt guested on Romesh's hip hop podcast attended Milan Fashion Week with LEIGH ANNE 👠 PINNOCK and appeared on The Big Fat Quiz with Joe and James but she played it cool claiming "nobody really knows me" so they're all starting from scratch yeah okay bestie we see the STRATEGY 🧠!!

BELLA 🗡️ RAMSEY is surprisingly well plugged in for one of the younger celebs having starred in GAME 🎮 OF THRONES with Sebastian Croft worked with James Blunt on Sunny Dancer got interviewed on Acaster's Off Menu podcast and had that cute vegan ish diet chat with Romesh on Jonathan Ross!! Sebastian himself admitted he barely knew anyone except Ramsey and was hyped to play with people who don't know how he operates but the real tea ☕ is Jerry Hall defending her 30 year neighbour Richard E Grant saying she's known him forever they've holidayed in Africa danced all night and even costarred in that ridiculous children's film TOOTH 🦷 together!! Their friendship is so tight they're basically moving in now and we are seated for the inevitable bin day arguments 🗑️!!

JULIE 🎙️ HESMONDHALGH is secretly the voice of Romesh's WEAKEST LINK show while also having fronted that Papyrus child safety campaign with Michael Sheen back in 2020!! King Kenny battled on Romesh's Would You Rather game show James Blunt and Leigh Anne are both BRIT AWARD winners who probably mingled at every afterparty and then you've got total lone wolves like Sharon Rooney and Myha'la who have almost zero prior connections which might actually be a sneaky advantage or a fast track to early banishment just like Niko and Ruth last year!! Leigh Anne herself said not being known beyond her Little Mix persona could help her fly under the radar and honestly with all these decade old friendships getting stress tested in the castle we are HERE 🍿 for every single backstabbing twist!!
